metrics.public_context_compression: public observation SHA vs pooled mission-front-door-target abstract keys; count distinct original public hashes compressed into same key, not physical pose aliasing
metrics.goal_credit_reach: original own selected event signals, assignments and positive-credit context-action keys including action0/1/2, supported alternatives and decision-time positive credit; per-family source development seeds; record original positive goal controls 4/9 ON and 4/9 OFF
metrics.weights_and_actor_rule: MG54 policy coefficients unchanged, source own selected only, no retuning or source world reset/step
metrics.resource: host existing resource receipts authenticated only, no claims equal native CPU/RSS/energy or unseen scientific heldout
